searchText: I'm getting excited https://ethresear.ch/t/the-safe-merge-proposal/11057 Very smart Does anyone know when the next phase of ETH 2.0 is? These GAS fees are out of control There is no ETH 2.0. The Merge is coming up as the next major network upgrade which will change from Proof of Work to Proof of Stake, but that isn't likely to have a direct impact on available blockspace. There is active research into a number of things that may help reduce demand or increase supply of block space, but none are available in a censorship resistant way yet (Layer 2 solutions are available, but not censorship resistant). Oh. I thought the SHARDS part of ETH 2.0 was supposed to increase capacity. Guess I read it wrong. Sharding is one of the many research projects that is happening, but it is still just in the research phase. Oh, ok. I hope they can do something soon ETH 2.0 isn't a thing. It was a poor choice in naming that people latched onto as a meme, but it isn't actually a thing. ah thank you meme?? https://ethereum.org/en/eth2/ I hound the Ethereum.org team almost every day about fixing the site. 😖 Looks fine to me 😉 naming it ETH PoS Upgrade would've saved so much headache
